if(MSVC)
    add_compile_options(/W0)
else()
    add_compile_options(-w)
endif()

list(PREPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/Modules")
set(CPM_DONT_UPDATE_MODULE_PATH ON CACHE BOOL "Use RedBolt's checked-in CMake modules" FORCE)
set(CPM_SOURCE_CACHE "${REDBOLT_DEPENDENCY_ROOT}" CACHE PATH "CPM dependency source cache" FORCE)
unset(CPM_DIRECTORY CACHE)
include("${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/CPM.cmake")
set(FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/deps")

redbolt_require_path("${REDBOLT_DEPENDENCY_ROOT}" "REDBOLT_DEPENDENCY_ROOT")

if(NOT COMMAND install_third_party_libs)
    function(install_third_party_libs)
    endfunction()
endif()

if(NOT COMMAND group_sources)
    function(group_sources)
    endfunction()
endif()

include(DotRecast.cmake)
include(SharpCpp.cmake)
include(SDL.cmake)
include(SDL_image.cmake)
include(Diligent.cmake)
include(DearImGui.cmake)
include(HarfBuzz.cmake)
include(RmlUi.cmake)
include(STB.cmake)
include(TinyGLTF.cmake)
include(LZ4.cmake)
include(WebP.cmake)
include(XAtlas.cmake)
include(Jolt.cmake)
include(Embree.cmake)
include(OpenSSL.cmake)
include(LibDataChannel.cmake)
add_custom_target(redbolt-native-dependency-batch
    DEPENDS SDL2 redbolt-diligent-build ImGui harfbuzz harfbuzz-raster harfbuzz-gpu rmlui_core rmlui_debugger Jolt embree datachannel-static
    COMMENT "Building RedBolt native dependency batch")
